business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Asset-light technology company operating on its own proprietary, flexible, scalable, cloud-based technology (established 2012) with an API-first, modular architecture allowing front-end and back-end to be improved independently. Capabilities have been extended across the payment value chain (in-store/online payments, affordability, VAS, transaction processing, prepaid issuing/acquiring and FinTech infrastructure) organically and through acquisitions aimed at adding specific technology and product capabilities: Qwikcilver/Pine Labs Prepaid (2019), Plural/Pine Labs Online (2021), Mosambee (2022, SMB in-store/online and affordability), QFix (2022, workflow management/SMB digitization), Setu (2022, API-based digital public infrastructure) and Credit+ (2023, full-stack issuing/acquiring/processing). It partners with acquiring banks and 40 credit partners (as of June 30, 2025); in affordability solutions the lenders bear consumer credit risk and the Company takes no consumer credit or default risk.
